description: Check the status of a spend approval raised when a batch or crawl is estimated above the key's approval_above_usd threshold. Use after alterlab_batch or alterlab_crawl returned status pending_approval with an approval_id: show the approval_url to your human, poll this tool (about every 30 seconds) until status is approved, then resubmit the identical request with approval_id. Status is pending, approved, denied or consumed. An API key cannot approve its own spend. Free.
name: alterlab_approval
title: Check Spend Approval
